allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Garware Technical Fibres Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 79412676 securities pursuant to Bonus at its meeting held on January 06, 2025

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Garware Technical Fibres Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Board meeting held on January 06, 2025 for allotment of 7,94,12,676 fully paid-up Bonus Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each in the ratio of 4: 1 i.e., 4 (four) new fully paid-up bonus equity shares of Rs. 10/- each for every 1 (one) existing fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 10/- each, to the eligible members of the Company whose names appeared in the Register of Members / Register of the Beneficial Owners, as on January 03, 2025, the "Record Date" fixed for this purpose..
